after.text: Ctrl+N opens New Download (or Tab to Add download and press Enter); paste a URL and press Enter (Ctrl+Enter submits several). Tab to the sidebar, use ↑ / ↓ to choose a filter such as Active or Queued, then Enter. Focus the list for Space / Enter / Ctrl+C / Ctrl+Backspace — those keys stay with the focused control when the list is not focused. In the list, ↑ / ↓ selects a row; Space pauses or resumes it, and Enter opens details. A focused row button runs on Enter or Space. Ctrl+C copies the URL; Ctrl+Backspace removes the selected row. Ctrl+I opens details; Tab to Show in folder. Ctrl+F finds. Escape closes the topmost dialog, then the inspector. Close the window to hide downloads; reopen Garia from the tray or app launcher. Ctrl+Q quits.
